# firebaseappdistribution_group (Resource)

A tester group in Firebase App Distribution. Groups are scoped to a Firebase project, not to an individual app; which app releases are distributed to a group is decided when a release is distributed. Use `firebaseappdistribution_group_member` to manage the testers in the group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "firebaseappdistribution_group" "qa" {
  group_id     = "qa"
  display_name = "QA team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human readable name shown in the Firebase console.
- `group_id` (String) Alias of the group, which becomes the last segment of its resource name and is what `releases:distribute` and the Firebase CLI refer to as the group alias. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Firebase project ID or number. Defaults to the provider `project`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Full resource name of the group, in the form `projects/{project_number}/groups/{group_id}`.
- `invite_link_count` (Number) Number of invite links for the group. Invite links are not exposed by the API and must be managed in the Firebase console.
- `name` (String) Full resource name of the group as returned by the API. Same as `id`.
- `release_count` (Number) Number of releases the group has access to.
- `tester_count` (Number) Number of testers in the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import firebaseappdistribution_group.qa projects/my-firebase-project/groups/qa
```
